briefText:
Page type: b2b product landing
Audience: enterprise software buyers
Objective: explain governed website generation and drive product evaluation
Must preserve semantic HTML.
Do not invent testimonials, metrics, customer logos, or pricing.

Page type: editorial feature
Audience: long-form readers
Objective: prioritize reading hierarchy and evidence-backed narrative
Must support reduced motion.
Do not invent authors, publications, metrics, or pricing.

Page type: premium consumer brand site
Audience: high-intent consumer buyers
Objective: present a distinctive premium product story with a clear action
Must preserve accessible commerce actions.
Do not invent customer logos, testimonials, metrics, or pricing.

Page type: motion-heavy creative site
Audience: creative technology audiences
Objective: create a paced interactive narrative without blocking the primary action
Must support reduced motion.
Never make motion required for comprehension.

Page type: interactive 2d experience
Audience: interactive product visitors
Objective: demonstrate a 2D experience while preserving semantic fallbacks
Must preserve semantic HTML.
Never require canvas for primary content.

Page type: interactive 3d showcase
Audience: spatial-interface visitors
Objective: demonstrate a governed 3D experience with a clear fallback path
Must support reduced motion.
Never require WebGL for primary content.
